year_range.label: Issue Year
year_range.description: Select the year of the deal.

sector.label: Sector
sector.description: Select the sector of the deal.

t1_return.label: T+1D Returns
t1_return.description: The return of deals on the first trade date from the pricing date.

t1m_returns.label: T+1M Returns
t1m_returns.description: The return of deals one month from the pricing date.

deal_value.label: Deal Value
deal_value.description: The total $ value of the offering or deal.

Sponsor.label: Sponsor
Sponsor.description: Choose whether the sponsor is involved in the deal.

Primary.label: Primary Percentage
Primary.description: Select a range or specific value for the primary category.

AllocationPercentOfDealSize.label: Allocation % DealSize (Simple)
AllocationPercentOfDealSize.description: Enter the allocation percentage of the deal size as a range.

AllocationPercentOfIOI.label: Allocation % IOI (Simple)
AllocationPercentOfIOI.description: Enter the allocation percentage of IOI as a range.

HoldPeriod.description: Specify the hold period as a range using input fields.
HoldPeriod.label: Hold Period

profitability.label: Profitability
profitability.description: Select the profitability status of the company.

liquidity.label: Liquidity
liquidity.description: Select the liquidity status of the company.

growth.label: Growth
growth.description: Select the growth status of the company.

price_to_earnings.label: Price to Earnings (PE)
price_to_earnings.description: The ratio of the company's share price to its earnings per share.

price_to_book.label: Price to Book (PB)
price_to_book.description: The ratio of the company's market value to its book value.

ev_sales.label: EV/Sales
ev_sales.description: The ratio of the company's enterprise value to its sales.

ev_ebitda.label: EV/EBITDA
ev_ebitda.description: The ratio of the company's enterprise value to its EBITDA.

div_yield.label: Div Yield
div_yield.description: The dividend yield of the company.

sales_growth.label: Sales Growth
sales_growth.description: The annual growth rate of the company's sales.

sales_growth_3y_cagr.label: Sales Growth 3Y/5R CAGR
sales_growth_3y_cagr.description: The 3-year or 5-year compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of the company's sales.

eps_growth.label: EPS Growth
eps_growth.description: The growth rate of the company's earnings per share (EPS).

eps_growth_3y_cagr.label: EPS Growth 3Y/5R CAGR
eps_growth_3y_cagr.description: The 3-year or 5-year compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of the company's earnings per share (EPS).

return_on_equity.label: Return on Equity (ROE)
return_on_equity.description: The company's return on equity, a measure of financial performance.

roce.label: ROCE
roce.description: The company's return on capital employed, a measure of profitability.

fcf_margin.label: FCF Margin
fcf_margin.description: The company's free cash flow margin, indicating cash flow efficiency.

sales_total_assets.label: Sales/Total Assets
sales_total_assets.description: The ratio of the company's sales to its total assets.

net_debt_fcf.label: Net Debt/FCF
net_debt_fcf.description: The ratio of the company's net debt to its free cash flow.

net_debt_ebitda.label: Net Debt/EBITDA
net_debt_ebitda.description: The ratio of the company's net debt to its EBITDA.

debt_equity.label: Debt/Equity
debt_equity.description: The ratio of the company's total debt to its equity.

52_week_high.label: 52 Week High
52_week_high.description: The current price in relation to the 52-week high.

52_week_low.label: 52 Week Low
52_week_low.description: The current price in relation to the 52-week low.

dma_20.label: DMA 20
dma_20.description: The current price in relation to the 20-day moving average.

dma_50.label: DMA 50
dma_50.description: The current price in relation to the 50-day moving average.

dma_200.label: DMA 200
dma_200.description: The current price in relation to the 200-day moving average.

rsi_14d.label: RSI (14D)
rsi_14d.description: Relative Strength Index (RSI) for the last 14 days.

beta.label: Beta
beta.description: Select the market risk level associated with the deal.

volatility.label: Volatility
volatility.description: Select the credit risk level associated with the deal.

piotroski_score.label: Piotroski Score
piotroski_score.description: Select the interest rate risk level associated with the deal.
